published_title: Til Death Star do us part
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Lemag''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in June 2000.
description: The Odd-lom deck I have been playing since Special Edition arrived. Went 3-0 at Dantooine regional in 2000 and 2-1 at last years regional (don't ask about the one loss to Odi-Wan)
cards: posted: Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes x4
What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?
posted: Never Tell Me The Odds x6
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Total 60 as published. No Objective: the strategy says 'Start the usual yavin start, like mains, but no swamp. I start Jungle', so Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room is set as the starting location; no starting Interrupt is named (Careful Planning is in the list).

Posted 'Push x3' (listed under Effects; the strategy says 'Catch or poke Torture with the Pushes') dested the Interrupt What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'Hoth War Room' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Yavin 4 Throne Room' Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room; 'EPP Luke/Han/Leia' Luke With Lightsaber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Wedge' Wedge Antilles; 'Leesub' Leesub Sirln; 'Signal' The Signal; Jungle and Farm are the Special Edition generic Light sites; Wise Advice is the Special Edition Effect (no Defensive Shields in 2000).
The 2-1 at 'last years regional' (1999) is not filed as a separate event.
